test_title: PYST 4: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
The price of a commodity increases 5% annually from 400.

What will be the approximate price at the end of the 4th year?
solution: **Que.** The price of a commodity increases 5% annually from 400. What will be the approximate price at the end of the 4th year? **Given:** • Initial price = 400 • Annual increase = 5% • Time = 4 years **Formula:** Final Price = P × (1 + r/100)ⁿ Where P = 400, r = 5, n = 4 Using formula directly: = 400 × (1.05)⁴ = 400 × 1.2155
